scripts.deps: docker compose down && docker volume rm -f ink-quests_backend-node-modules ink-quests_frontend-node-modules && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec backend npm run db:generate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run db:seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U inkquests
